Thanks for the ping. Quick notes:

- Subprocessor matrix: OK to share CSV with columns: vendor, function, data categories (IDs, logs, telemetry), access type, location, last attestation date. Redact IP addresses and internal hostnames. I'll attach an export.
- SOC2: we can share the SOC2 Type II summary PDF publicly; full report requires an NDA — recommend sending the summary and offering to start a secure NDA + report delivery if they need the full report.
- EU transfers: We rely on standard contractual clauses (SCCs) and have an adequacy fallback for certain partners. For this pilot, SCCs + internal supplementary measures should suffice.
- KMS/HSM: we use customer-managed key options for Private deployments; for hosted accounts we offer KMS integration (GCP CMEK/AWS KMS) for keys-at-rest and HSM-backed key wrapping for enterprise customers. For pilot, offer details and architecture diagram if requested.

Redlines to pre-clear: limitation of liability carveouts tied to tokenized data processing; retention periods — suggest we pre-approve 30/90/365 day retention buckets based on environment (dev/staging/prod) and push back on open-ended indefinite retention.

Attaching: subprocessor_matrix_20260601.csv (stub)

-marcus
Product Security Lead
Redwood Inference
